answer: An identity must present a vehicle registration with a real history: the vehicle, its owner, and its registration renewals are recorded by the transport authority. An atlas shows the world as it is, and the registry shows vehicles as they are: one owner, one history. The canyon of a farm's registrations is deep and narrow: all registered in the same week, all the same model, all under similar names. The river of a real registration flows year after year, with renewals and inspections on record, and the authority's own database is the proof no farm can forge.
